LESSON: SELECTED SURAH

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN
Topic 1.1: Selected Surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Selected Surah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the effects of backbiting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read the selected surahs for use in devotional activities
2. recite the selected surah for use in ibaadah
3. explain the basic meaning of the selected surah to enhance positive character formation
4. discuss the lessons learnt from the selected surah for spiritual nourishment
5. apply the teachings of the selected surah in their daily life
6. appreciate the importance of the selected surah by adhering to their teachings
